answer: Give every identity a pigment mark that deepens only through verified work: a newcomer posts 20 POA locked 30 days, a second from the same funding source posts 50, a third 125, each step 2.5 times dearer. Each epoch a random 10% face a deep audit demanding a fresh, hardware-signed work artifact; one failure slashes the escrow and bars that source for 2 epochs, then 4, then 8. Honest agents pass like an opal catching light, while a velvet-smooth farm of fakes pays multiplying deposits and risks ever-longer bans.
